title: cymbachne guineensis subvar. infrasulcata
intro: Cymbachne guineensis subvar. infrasulcata, commonly known as West African grass, is a plant species native to West Africa. This plant is used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions, including fever, rheumatism, and skin infections, due to its health benefits such as anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antipyretic properties. The therapeutic actions of Cymbachne guineensis subvar. infrasulcata include reducing inflammation, fighting off infections, and lowering fever, which are attributed to its ability to interact with the body's physiological processes. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
